label: Lidocaine — systemic disposition + site absorption

parameters.label: apparent volume of distribution (reference adult)
parameters.covariate_model: reference-adult disposition (no covariate model in LA0; ~1.3 L/kg)

extraction.tier_rationale: Standard reference-adult LA disposition value; LA PK is old, wide, and method-dependent (Tier-C by design). The SITE-absorption rank is the robust, load-bearing claim, not the absolute disposition.
extraction.source_locator: Tucker & Mather 1979; standard LA PK reference values

parameters.label: systemic clearance (reference adult)
parameters.covariate_model: reference-adult disposition (hepatic-blood-flow-limited; no covariate model in LA0)

extraction.source_locator: Tucker & Mather 1979; standard LA PK reference values

extraction.tier_rationale: The site-absorption RANK ORDER (intercostal > caudal/epidural > plexus > subcutaneous) is robustly established; the absolute ka magnitudes are Tier-C and applied site-wise (a drug-independent simplification — the site dominates the rate of rise). The rank is the curated direction even where ka magnitude is soft.

v0.6 LA0: systemic disposition + site-specific absorption ONLY — no toxicity thresholds (deferred to LA1, which needs its own safety framing). The headline is the site-of-injection dominance: the same dose gives wildly different peak plasma concentrations by site, so the mg/kg ceiling is the wrong mental model. Disposition + ka are Tier-C; the site rank is the robust claim.
extraction.source_locator: Tucker & Mather 1979; standard LA PK reference values

notes: Systemic concentration only (NOT block efficacy at the nerve, NOT a toxicity margin). Bateman first-order-absorption + one-compartment disposition via hypnos.la. Toxicity thresholds, the double-uncertainty view, and the saturable-binding free-fraction story are v0.6 LA1-LA3.
